title: Data for the universal quotient-sequence comparison and prescribed shifts
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and a scheme $W$. Use the ordinary quotient-sequence adjoints [def-pur-sequence-adjoint-resolution-data] and supplied coefficient calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Define a universal comparison to consist of a left-derived pair $(L,\epsilon)$, a normalized universal counit for reduction, and their uniquely counit-compatible isomorphism. Define its resolution-comparison data by the inverse-denominator formulas, naturality, finite-evaluation, and two/three-resolution identities. Define its shift-comparison data by coherent integer shifts, their counit and finite-resolution squares, the identity term formulas, signed differentials, quotient-transition square and derived finite-evaluation square. For the actual total tensor [def-coef-ringed-tensor-hom-model], fix its first input and define the second-factor generator formula to multiply the summand of first degree $p$ by $(-1)^{rp}$. These are exactly the existing data definitions of lem-pur-sequence-kflat-comparison-shifts, relocated without altering any field.
